info.title: Fire-X Backend
info.description: Minimal run creation and persistent query, image upload with same-frame metadata, and serial background processing. algorithm_mode is unconfigured; image processing runs only when an explicit provider (e.g. fixture) is enabled.

AtlasFireStatusItem.title: AtlasFireStatusItem
AtlasFireStatusItem.description:
Per-run map feedback summary (A1).

``alert_status`` is the derived display state; ``fire_detected``/``is_fresh``
expose the two raw inputs it is computed from. Only ``fire`` is a current
alert; ``stale`` observations stay visible but are historical.

CaptureRecord.title: CaptureRecord
CaptureRecord.description: A received capture and its processing status (queued/processing/completed/failed).

Detection2D.title: Detection2D
Detection2D.description:
A single 2D detection box in original image pixels (A2 YOLO output).

``bbox`` is ``[x1, y1, x2, y2]`` with ``x2 > x1``, ``y2 > y1`` and all values
finite. This is image-plane evidence only — it never claims world position.

FirePatch.title: FirePatch
FirePatch.description:
A fire polygon in minimal local XZ coordinates.

``geometry`` is an ordered ring of ``[x, z]`` pairs that closes on itself
(first vertex == last vertex). All values must be finite. This is the local
surface frame; world meaning comes from ``coordinate_frame_id``.

FlameEstimate.title: FlameEstimate
FlameEstimate.description: One visible flame section in the run's local metre frame, not a volume.

ReconstructionFrame.title: ReconstructionFrame
ReconstructionFrame.description: One published reconstruction frame in a run's history (read-only).

ReconstructionJob.title: ReconstructionJob
ReconstructionJob.description: An uploaded-ZIP reconstruction task and its status (queued -> processing -> completed/failed).

ReconstructionSummary.title: ReconstructionSummary
ReconstructionSummary.description:
Latest published offline reconstruction frame for a run (read-only).

``status`` is ``none`` until a frame is published, so "no result" is an
explicit state rather than a fabricated empty frame.
